cohort: The study analyzed data from 2,114 children in a nationwide Japanese birth cohort, linking the 21st Century Longitudinal Survey of Newborns with the Perinatal Research Network database.
finding: Cesarean delivery (CD) was not significantly associated with most long-term child health or developmental outcomes up to 9 years of age in this Japanese cohort.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not significantly associated with adverse long-term child health or developmental outcomes.
